verdict.rationale: Swell documents a full backend REST API with official Node/PHP libraries, key-based auth, webhooks, runtime schema introspection, and a CLI for app/store management, all publicly documented and independently verified via runtime probes (CLI installs and runs). This clearly supports programmatic, AI-native driving of the product. missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt (both probes 404), so machine-readable spec discovery is absent.
